purpose: Preserve native nested Back navigation, then finish the Maps activity and remove its own root task from Recents at app exit.
patch_name: 戻るで終了して履歴から削除

api33_plus.registration: Lamet.aw installs native Likh adapters. Likh.c(Z) delegates to e(Z), which registers/unregisters the system OnBackInvokedCallback according to enabled native handlers.
api33_plus.root_problem: When native handlers are absent or disabled, the system may handle root Back directly. Changing only Lpw.x or Lnce.onBackPressed would not cover that route.
api33_plus.solution: Register one always-enabled native handler before all feature handlers. The existing dispatcher remains active at the map root, including API33+ Back dispatch. No separate system listener or manifest opt-out is introduced.

transformation.payload_alignment: Four inserted code units preserve even alignment of existing switch and array payloads. DEX builder relocates branches and payload references; output audit must restore the two inserted instructions and compare the original method.
transformation.install_scope: instanceof com.google.android.maps.MapsActivity; non-Maps objects, other activity types, and null do not register anything.
transformation.constructor: Passes true to the existing Lqi(Z) constructor, then stores the Activity.
transformation.back_action: Activity.finishAndRemoveTask() through the stored Activity. Shared tasks retain the public Android API behavior; no enumeration, global task removal, or process kill.
transformation.extension_delivery: One generated DEX class through BytecodePatch extension Supplier; no externally fetched runtime asset.
transformation.reapplication: Explicit guard rejection if the generated callback already exists; target method fingerprints also reject modified or previously patched native code.

priority_proof.selection: Likd.a(I) returns the first enabled handler. Later native feature handlers are added ahead of the first-installed fallback.
priority_proof.invariant: The added fallback runs only when no later native handler consumes Back; it is not a blanket replacement of Back.

native_behavior_preserved.main_layout_panel: Lnxz, registered from MainLayout through Lamet.au, delegates to native panel Back and disables itself afterward.
native_behavior_preserved.api35_fragment_navigation: Lndz, obtained through Lnce.bg/Lnea and registered during native onCreate, pops the existing fragment stack.
native_behavior_preserved.startup_handoff: Lnce.ap(Z) contains a finish() used from startup/resume-related branches, not ordinary Back. It remains unchanged.
native_behavior_preserved.input_method: No KeyEvent, pre-IME, keyboard, window, or overlay-priority handler is added or replaced.
native_behavior_preserved.existing_maps_patches: No edit to Lnce lifecycle/touch methods used by startup location, or Lafhc category-row suppression.
native_behavior_preserved.other_activities: The shared factory executes one small guard, but only MapsActivity receives the additional callback; no other activity has its back behavior altered.
